name: Langfuse MCP Server
summary: Native, authenticated MCP server built into Langfuse so agents can read and write traces, prompts and other project data.
description: Stateless Streamable HTTP; each API key is scoped to one project (Basic Auth header). Regional cloud endpoints (EU https://cloud.langfuse.com/api/public/mcp, US, Japan) plus self-hosted. Read and write tools enabled by default. A separate public Docs MCP is at https://langfuse.com/api/mcp. Tools are listed at mcp.reference.langfuse.com.

agent_access.notes: Basic Auth with the project's public/secret key pair.
